prompt_scope: General rubric changes only. No names, example scores, generator identifiers or held-out labels in prompts.
quality_selection: After all four tune rounds, evaluate unchanged prompts on check9. Minimize group-balanced mean MAE across quality and aesthetics; invalid scalars cost4. Within0.05 choose shorter prompt, then lower cost.
ai_selection: Report all four rounds against own visual suspicion; no recall tuning on six shared-prompt positives. Freeze general round4 unless development evidence shows a clear regression. No heldout threshold fitting.
effort_selection: Compare low and medium on the12 fixed development images for each task/model, alternating effort order by image. Select low unless medium improves quality+aesthetics MAE by at least0.10 without worse valid coverage. Inspect AI error tradeoffs as guard, not independent provenance accuracy.
heldout: 60 different quality/aesthetics images plus60 separate AI-origin images. All three models receive same bytes. Freeze prompts and effort before opening heldout model outcomes.
delivery: Full frame, EXIF orientation, RGB, maxedge512, no upscaling, JPEG92 subsampling0.
limitations: Own original assessments were not blind to prior session predictions. Check9 has noAI positives. New model-reference labels are not human gold. Similar effort names do not imply equal compute. Source-pretraining overlap cannot be ruled out.
